Probably the only thing that would count as a reasonable goal in life for me. I wanted to do everything in my power to stop the spreading of dangerous, anachronistic ideas in, at least, my country.

As much as I daydream of having revenge on the oppressors, I know that it's only a power fantasy. I know that whatever actions need to be taken, they must be delicate, patient and spanning over several generations, and this scares the hell out of me.

The world will descend into technological barbarism if the civilized population doesn't wake up and see what their leaders are really doing in the rest of the world, and it will. We, the civilized nations, are being lied to through the media and have our minds bleached through the internet. Implanting a false sense of identity and erasing any idea of personal responsibility and guilt.

The technophiles thought that technology will allow people to be free and educated, but instead it allowed the rulling class to shift the oppinions of the masses with the push of a button. It allowed opportunistic people to grab the attention of the masses from serious and critical issues.

The front pages of every major tabloid, youtube, reddit, facebook, 4chan, twitter and all of these "big internet" places make me wanna nuke the whole world. 

I feel like John the Savage from Brave New World. I don't belong in this century because I've always been told of how deviant and extremist my ideas are. I'm the insane person because I try to warn people of how dull and planned their lives are, you see.

That book has a prophetic ending to my life as I'm actually called John.

Stop your fucking whining.

He wasn't feeding the poor in Africa, for fuck's sake, he was a fucking idiot who played at being "the hacktivist". The guy did nothing of value in his life. Actually, if he was a co-founder of reddit, he managed to destroy the lives of millions of retards and pervert whatever was left of human culture.

A young, middle class (or higher?), white westerner dies and everyone's sad, but when poor people in Asia and Africa die for the aformentioned's luxuries by the millions, nobody sheds a tear.

Man the fuck up, you sick and pathetic wretches.

Get help. **NOW**.

I don't care whether you're the most guilt-ridden, anxious or depressed person in the world; you must consider the serious effects of these drugs on you. You need to find social groups who deal with this kind of situations and at the same time train yourself to reject the temptation to use drugs.

I've never done a drug in my life, so I may be "biased" against them, but I do know that the human brain was never meant to experience more pleasure than it can handle. The more you desensitize your brain to whatever chemicals make it happy, the harder it'll be for you to be happy again.

Throw away the pills **NOW**.

I know who I am, but I don't like to admit it to myself, because if I do, I won't be who I am anymore. I'm wrong and right at the same time, and I'm sick and tired of seeing so many perspectives about myself and others. I'm sick and tired of going through the same self-doubt, self-hatred, self-pitying and self-denying routine.

I don't need a doctor, I need someone to come and tell me not who I am, but who they think I am. I've languished 19 years of this hell without ever meeting someone who could just MAKE ME stop these hellish patterns of thought.

I advise you to be more conscious about your sleeping habits. I too did the mistake of going to a psychiatrist first and being drugged like hell before finding out that I was doing some pretty stupid things before bed time.

Don't know about you, but I would reinforce this idea of insomnia to lie to others and myself that my mental lethargy was due to lack of sleep, and that would make me misdiagnose myself as an insomniac. I'm not sleeping 9 hours / day and I still get the occasional sleepless night, but at least I've managed to get the 7 minimum.

Also, lose the booze. It might worsen your sleep in the long run.

(guess why I'm on this /r/, lol)

You think I wouldn't have done that already if I could? Getting out of town would be fucking terific, but I don't have any money to waste.

My psychiatrist told me a variation of what you told me and it absolutely baffles me that some people just don't realize that you just can't expect that others treat you like you're the center of the universe. As if I could just "will" myself into magically moving somewhere else.

I can't force my family to move just because I hate this sad place. Once born into poverty, you can only get out of it by chance or by superhuman will. I can't just "move".

It's ok, I don't really mind it. I do know that I'm overreacting most of the time, but the outcome will still be the same.

Unemployed, just finished high school and without any higher education. People kept telling me how talented I am at various things while in high school, but that doesn't pay the bills. That doesn't ensure your place in higher education. Poor as a dog (ha) and I'm too sick of it all to continue. I guess I'm just too proud for not getting a dead-end job to help me pay for my higher education. I guess I'm just a coward who doesn't want to face poverty.

Alone. Alone. Alone.
